verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is an audio/video multimedia framework for recording, converting and streaming media. Converting between document markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) is outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability.

support.subject: As a developer, markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) convert between each other
